## Products Manufactured
1. **Fully Automatic Long Wick Machine:** High-speed automated long cotton wick (Phool Batti / Lambi Batti) making machine for commercial production. URL: https://cottonwicksmachine.in/fully-automatic-long-wick/
2. **Semi-Automatic Long Wick Machine:** Cost-effective, easy-to-operate long cotton wick machine ideal for small businesses and home startups. URL: https://cottonwicksmachine.in/semi-automatic-long-wick/
3. **Automatic Cotton Cutter Machine (Standard & Lot Production):** Precision cotton cutting machine available in Standard and High-Capacity Lot Production variants. URL: https://cottonwicksmachine.in/cotton-cutter-machine/
4. **Round Cotton Wick Machine with Feeder:** Automated round cotton wick (Gol Batti) machine equipped with an automatic cotton feeder system. URL: https://cottonwicksmachine.in/round-cotton-wick/
